entry.description: Restrict `flume-sdk` to the client API, so client applications no longer depend on the plugin API, which moves to `flume-core`. `Event` moves to `org.apache.flume.event`, `RpcClient` extends `AutoCloseable`, and the client API reports failures with the new unchecked `FlumeClientException` instead of `EventDeliveryException` and `FlumeException`
